checks.name: Manager creates and saves an order with a site, dependent section, collector, reason, catalog item and quantity
Manager view does not expose warehouse approval or issue buttons
Same order appears in the warehouse's third source tab
Warehouse approval preserves issued quantity and cost at zero
Issue button is disabled above the selected lot balance
Partial issue records one unit and leaves the order approved
Issue button is disabled above the order's remaining quantity
Second issue completes the order and records the second lot's own cost
Inventory stock visibly decreases from 2 to 0
Return button rejects empty reason and quantity above the original delivery quantity
First return refunds the first lot's 10 SAR cost and leaves a 20 SAR net cost
Second return refunds the second lot's 20 SAR cost and leaves zero net cost
Full return restores inventory stock to 2 and restores each original lot's balance to 1
Completed order does not expose new issue buttons after return; fully returned deliveries expose no return buttons
Order status, original deliveries, returned quantities and zero net cost persist after a full page reload

limits: No direct SQL reconciliation or database schema inspection was performed.

Existing stock accounting valuation and the aggregate execution-cost report were not independently reconciled in this flow.
No business code was changed during this test.
